entry.title: Nanopillar metasurfaces uniting high optical reflectivity with ultracoherent nanomechanics
entry.summary:
Mechanically compliant mirrors are key components in cavity optomechanics. However, the requirements to achieve the best optical and mechanical performance are usually in direct competition. A high reflectivity for tightly focused beams entails thick reflectors, whereas ultracoherent flexural nanomechanics necessitates thin membranes.

Source: arXiv Quantum & Condensed Matter (quant-ph, cond-mat) · Tags: #quantum-computing #condensed-matter #optics-photonics

entry.title: Wigner crystals get dressed
entry.summary:
Nature Physics, Published online: 22 October 2026; doi:10.1038/s41567-026-03516-9 When repulsion overcomes their tendency to move freely, electrons can arrange into a crystal. Two experiments have now identified Wigner polarons, quasiparticles whose optical signatures reveal the collective response of the electron lattice.

Source: Nature Physics · Tags: #quantum-physics #optics-photonics #post-quantum

entry.title: Teleportation transition of surface codes on a superconducting quantum processor
entry.summary:
Nature Physics, Published online: 22 October 2026; doi:10.1038/s41567-026-03484-0 Quantum teleportation is often discussed for individual quantum systems, but fault-tolerant quantum computers will encode information in multiqubit states. Now teleportation of surface code logical states has been demonstrated.

Source: Nature Physics · Tags: #quantum-physics #optics-photonics #quantum-computing #condensed-matter

entry.title: Superconductivity and ferroelectric orbital magnetism in semimetallic rhombohedral hexalayer graphene
entry.summary:
Nature Physics, Published online: 21 October 2026; doi:10.1038/s41567-026-03443-9 The semimetallic regime in rhombohedral graphene has not been extensively explored. Now, correlated insulators, superconductivity and multiferroic orbital magnetic order are demonstrated in semimetallic rhombohedral hexalayer graphene.

Source: Nature Physics · Tags: #quantum-physics #optics-photonics #combinatorics #condensed-matter
